verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a programmatic API reference covering datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments and API keys. It also offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec, which users can load into their own tooling as a workaround for interactivity. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-browser API explorer with runnable examples, and probes of common OpenAPI paths returned 404. Missing for 10: interactive 'try it' API explorer, runnable request examples in the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
